import os

tf.get_logger().setLevel('ERROR')

Paramétrés de l’exécution et les flux de lecture des fichiers TFRecors
¶

In [7]:
image_size,batch_size,epochs,dictLabels,nombreClasses,pipelineApprentissage,pipelineValidation = \
       initParametresExecution(image_size=(36, 36, 3),
                            batch_size = 8,
                            epochs=24,
                            repertoire='../donnees/BloodMNIST36x36-8',
                            cycle_length=None,
                            deterministic=None,
                            repetition=1,
                            bufferAleatoire=1024)
In [8]:
print(f"""
  image_size    = {image_size}
  batch_size    = {batch_size}
  epochs        = {epochs}
  nombreClasses = {nombreClasses}
  dictLabels    = {dictLabels}
       """)

  image_size    = (36, 36, 3)
  batch_size    = 8
  epochs        = 24
  nombreClasses = 8
  dictLabels    = {0: 'basophil', 1: 'eosinophil', 2: 'erythroblast', 3: 'immature', 4: 'lymphocyte', 5: 'monocyte', 6: 'neutrophil', 7: 'platelet'}

repertoireModelSauvegarde4 = '../ResultatsExecutions/4.1-bloodMNIST-CNN-PersonaliseMNIST-36x36-4-bs32-epochs128/model.sauvegardes/sauvegarde'
In [16]:
model = tf.keras.models.load_model(os.path.join(repertoireModelSauvegarde4,'CNN-PersonaliseMNIST-36x36-4-bs32-epochs128.keras'))
In [17]:
model.save_weights(os.path.join(repertoireSauvegardes,'CNN-PersonaliseMNIST-36x36-4-bs32-epochs128.weights.h5'), overwrite=True)
In [18]:
preprocessData = tf.keras.Sequential([
            keras.layers.Rescaling(1.0 / 255),
        ])

model = modelPersonaliseInception(image_size, 
                   nombreClasses, 
                   activation=keras.ops.gelu,
                   listeFiltres = [64,128,96,64],
                   preprocessData=preprocessData)
In [19]:
model.compile(
        optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(1e-03), 
        loss=keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(),
        metrics=[keras.metrics.SparseCategoricalAccuracy(name='accuracy')],
    )
In [20]:
model.load_weights(os.path.join(repertoireSauvegardes,'CNN-PersonaliseMNIST-36x36-4-bs32-epochs128.weights.h5'), skip_mismatch=True)
In [21]:
model.summary()

Evolution du taux d'apprentissage
¶

In [23]:
def evolutionTauxApprentissage( epoch,
                                initial_lrate=1e-05,
                                max_lrate=1e-03,
                                min_lrate=1e-05,
                                epochs_runup_lrate=2,
                                epochs_sustain_lrate=1,
                                drop_lrate=0.86):
    if epoch < epochs_runup_lrate:
        lrate = (max_lrate - initial_lrate) / epochs_runup_lrate * epoch + initial_lrate
    elif epoch < epochs_runup_lrate + epochs_sustain_lrate:
        lrate = max_lrate
    else:
        lrate = (max_lrate - min_lrate) * drop_lrate**(epoch - epochs_runup_lrate - epochs_sustain_lrate) + min_lrate
    return lrate
In [24]:
rng = [i for i in range(epochs)]
y = [evolutionTauxApprentissage( x) for x in rng]
plt.plot(rng, y)

print(f"L'évolution du taux d'apprentissage : du {y[0]:.3g} à {min(y):.3g}")
